verified: Kymera's announcement states that BROADEN2 met all primary and secondary endpoints, including statistically significant placebo comparisons at all three doses and a safety profile led by mild-to-moderate conjunctivitis.
unconfirmed: Independent verification is absent because the data have not been peer-reviewed or published; the available report omits trial size, full safety data and durability beyond 16 weeks, and no regulatory timeline is given.

verified: Kymera 称 BROADEN2 二期试验达到所有主要和次要终点，三个剂量组在 16 周时相对安慰剂均有统计学显著改善，中等剂量组安慰剂校正后改善峰值 45%，EASI-75 比例为 62% 对 22%；结膜炎在低、中、高剂量组分别为 20%、13%、11%，均属轻中度且未导致停药。
unconfirmed: 完整疗效与安全性数据尚未发表或经同行评审，具体终点数值、统计学细节仅见于公司公告；KT-621 与 Dupixent 等现有疗法的直接对比、三期试验时间表以及任何监管申报计划，均未在报道中给出。

titles.en: Kymera's oral eczema drug KT-621 meets Phase 2 endpoints
titles.zh: Kymera 口服 STAT6 降解剂 KT-621 二期湿疹试验达全部终点
